name: lta-review-dashboard-tests
description: Root-level devDependencies for tests/ -- the actual app dependencies live in dashboard/package.json. This exists only so Node test files under tests/ (which sits outside dashboard/'s node_modules resolution path) can import bcryptjs directly to build fixture account hashes, and (Phase B.11) can import stripe directly to exercise its real, static webhooks.constructEvent()/generateTestHeaderString() signature helpers in tests -- pinned to the exact same version installed in dashboard/package.json.
